text: Forsaken Hollow enemies are found amid structures and objects that reflect the specific place and moment where their connection to grace was severed, such as religious sites or residential areas.
Some Forsaken Hollows appear near still-functioning sites of grace but are unable to receive its light due to their severed connection, not physical distance.
The demon connected to the cursed blades can be found as a boss-type enemy in Limveld.
The Raider's first arena opponent is a Gladiator wearing armor similar to the Warden Duelists, exiled fighters from the coliseum associated with the Golden Order.
The Raider's second arena opponent is an Elder Lion, after which the Iron Menial learns the Raider's true identity.
Other Crucible Knights, such as Devonia, also gain unusual body parts like wings, tails, or altered lower halves, though the Executor's transformation is more extreme than most.
